Koffi 3.1.1 is an existing fixed dependency of the DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 Linux bundle. The verified bundle SHA-256 is `5bcf1cd3888f7db53567ef87ab797f9e1b5f7046f369bc90e5087fbdc1d01e08`. This repository's Android persistence adapter uses its synchronous libc interface to call `renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE)` and read errno, retaining the first-party file lock, synced temporary file, JSONL format and refusal to overwrite an existing session. It does not install a new Koffi package or execute package installation scripts.

The exact packaged license is MIT, Copyright (C) 2026 Niels Martignène. `LICENSE.txt` is copied unchanged from that fixed bundle and has SHA-256 `22bcbbbacd739b026a8dc484f62a31484ce4c4e31f3408b60b29b4e41d62b290`. The downloaded DSH bundle also retains the package's license. The historical GitHub mirror commit `2294ba0fa05b6edf1c87c6d9fbe8c66e98b313fe` is a research reference and is not a substitute for the exact npm 3.1.1 source/version/license evidence.

Sources: https://www.npmjs.com/package/koffi/v/3.1.1 and https://github.com/Koromix/koffi . The implementation and validation boundaries are recorded in `docs/research/mobile-pc-parity/REPORT.md` and `HANDOVER.md`.
